# Context menu

> Right-click actions next to the object.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add Context menu to this project exactly as specified here.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Components it uses.** Context menu imports 2 other components. Install them first, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Each doc lists its files; the download script below covers them too.
   - `popover`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/popover.md
   - `dropdown-menu`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/dropdown-menu.md
3. **Create the files.** Create every file under [Files](#files) at its exact path, with exactly the contents shown. If you can run shell commands, the download script below does this and the step before in one go.
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/popover.css";
   @import "./components/dropdown-menu.css";
   @import "./components/context-menu.css";
   ```

5. **Use it.** `import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, … } from '@/ui/components/context-menu';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Component: ContextMenu

A menu of actions that opens at the pointer on right-click, at a long press on touch, or from the keyboard. It reuses the DropdownMenu panel, items and keyboard model: only the trigger and the anchor differ.

#### Anatomy
```
<ContextMenu>                    context: open state, ids, pointer point
  <ContextMenuTrigger>           the area: <div class="ui-context-menu-trigger" tabindex="0">
  <ContextMenuContent>           <div class="ui-floating ui-menu ui-context-menu" role="menu" popover="manual">
    <ContextMenuItem />          role="menuitem"            = DropdownMenuItem
    <ContextMenuCheckboxItem />  role="menuitemcheckbox"    = DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
    <ContextMenuRadioGroup> <ContextMenuRadioItem />
    <ContextMenuLabel /> <ContextMenuSeparator /> <ContextMenuGroup />
    <ContextMenuSub> <ContextMenuSubTrigger /> <ContextMenuSubContent />
```
Item parts and classes are the dropdown menu's: `.ui-menu-item`, `.ui-menu-icon`, `.ui-menu-shortcut`, `.ui-menu-separator`, `.ui-menu-label`.

#### Props
- `ContextMenu`: `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`.
- `ContextMenuTrigger`: `asChild`, `disabled` (browser menu shows), `longPressDelay` (default 500), `tabIndex` (default 0 unless `asChild`).
- `ContextMenuContent`: `placement` (default `bottom-start`), `offset` (default 2), all floating-panel props except `anchorRef`.
- Items: same props as the DropdownMenu counterpart (`icon`, `shortcut`, `variant="destructive"`, `disabled`, `onSelect(event)`, `inset`, `checked`, `value`).

#### Behaviour
- `contextmenu` event on the area: `preventDefault()`, open with a virtual anchor (a 0×0 rect at `clientX/clientY`). Opened with the pointer, focus lands on the menu itself, nothing highlighted.
- Touch / pen: `pointerdown` starts a 500ms timer; it is cancelled by `pointerup`, `pointercancel`, or movement over 10px; when it fires the menu opens at the touch point (the browser's own `contextmenu` event that Android sends afterwards just re-opens at the same point).
- Keyboard: `Shift + F10` or the `ContextMenu` key on the focused area (or a descendant) opens the menu under the focused element with the first item focused. The browser's follow-up `contextmenu` event within 400ms is ignored.
- Right-clicking again (on the area or elsewhere) closes the open menu (outside `pointerdown`), then opens a new one at the new point. Only one menu is ever open.
- Esc closes and returns focus to the area; a click outside closes without moving focus. Tab closes. Choosing an item closes it unless `onSelect` calls `preventDefault()`.
- Positioning flips and shifts to stay at least 8px inside the viewport. The panel's own `contextmenu` is suppressed.

#### Visual rules
- Area: `-webkit-touch-callout: none`; on coarse pointers `user-select: none`; keyboard focus ring `0 0 0 3px` of `--ui-ring` at 45%, `--radius-md`.
- Panel and items: exactly the dropdown menu's (`.ui-menu`: min-width 8rem, padding 4px, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-surface-raised`, `--ui-shadow-lg`; item 32px high, `--radius-md`, highlight `--ui-accent`).

#### Motion
- Open: `ui-pop-in` 150ms ease-out from the pointer (scale .96, no travel). Close: `ui-pop-out` 160ms.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA menu pattern, as the dropdown menu; `aria-label="Context menu"` on the panel (overridable).
- The area is a tab stop so keyboard users can reach the menu. A context menu must never be the only way to reach an action.

#### Acceptance checks
- Right-click opens within 3px of the pointer; a second right-click moves it; only one `role="menu"` exists.
- Shift+F10 opens on the first item; arrows, Home/End, wrap; Esc returns focus to the area.
- Long press opens at 500ms and not earlier; moving the finger cancels it.
- Submenu opens with → and closes with ←.
- No serious axe violations while open (light and dark).

### `ui/components/context-menu/context-menu.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { useHoverIntent } from '../../hooks/use-hover-intent';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import { FloatingContent, type FloatingContentProps } from '../popover/floating-content';
import {
  MenuPanelContext,
  MenuRootContext,
  focusItem,
  isOwnEvent,
  ownedItems,
  useMenuRoot,
  type ActiveSub,
  type OpenMethod,
} from '../dropdown-menu/menu-context';

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

type PointAnchor = { getBoundingClientRect(): DOMRect };

interface ContextMenuContextValue {
  /** Virtual anchor: a zero-size rect at the pointer. */
  anchorRef: RefObject<PointAnchor | null>;
  openAt: (x: number, y: number, method: OpenMethod) => void;
}

const ContextMenuContext = createContext<ContextMenuContextValue | null>(null);

function useContextMenuContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(ContextMenuContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <ContextMenu>.`);
  return ctx;
}

export interface ContextMenuProps {
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Called when the menu asks to open or close. */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * ContextMenu — a menu of actions at the pointer. Right-click, long-press on
 * touch, or Shift+F10 / the ContextMenu key from keyboard focus. Same menu
 * pattern, parts and keyboard as the DropdownMenu.
 */
export function ContextMenu({ open: openProp, defaultOpen = false, onOpenChange, children }: ContextMenuProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const openMethod = useRef<OpenMethod>('pointer');
  const skipFocusReturn = useRef(false);
  const point = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const anchorRef = useRef<PointAnchor | null>({
    getBoundingClientRect: () => new DOMRect(point.current.x, point.current.y, 0, 0),
  });
  const closeMenu = useCallback(() => setOpen(false), [setOpen]);

  const openAt = useCallback(
    (x: number, y: number, method: OpenMethod) => {
      point.current = { x, y };
      openMethod.current = method;
      setOpen(true);
    },
    [setOpen],
  );

  const root = useMemo(
    () => ({
      open,
      setOpen,
      triggerRef,
      triggerId: `${id}-trigger`,
      contentId: `${id}-content`,
      openMethod,
      skipFocusReturn,
      closeMenu,
    }),
    [open, setOpen, id, closeMenu],
  );
  const own = useMemo(() => ({ anchorRef, openAt }), [openAt]);

  return (
    <ContextMenuContext.Provider value={own}>
      <MenuRootContext.Provider value={root}>{children}</MenuRootContext.Provider>
    </ContextMenuContext.Provider>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

const LONG_PRESS_MS = 500;
const LONG_PRESS_SLOP = 10;

export interface ContextMenuTriggerProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Render the child element as the area instead of a wrapping <div>. */
  asChild?: boolean;
  /** Turn the custom menu off: the browser's own context menu shows. */
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Touch long-press time, ms. Default 500. */
  longPressDelay?: number;
}

/**
 * The area that owns the menu. It is focusable (tabIndex 0) so keyboard users
 * can open the menu with Shift+F10 / the ContextMenu key; pass `tabIndex={-1}`
 * or `asChild` on an element that is already focusable to change that.
 */
export const ContextMenuTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ContextMenuTriggerProps>(function ContextMenuTrigger(
  {
    asChild,
    disabled,
    longPressDelay = LONG_PRESS_MS,
    className,
    tabIndex,
    onContextMenu,
    onKeyDown,
    onPointerDown,
    onPointerMove,
    onPointerUp,
    onPointerCancel,
    ...props
  },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const root = useMenuRoot('ContextMenuTrigger');
  const cm = useContextMenuContext('ContextMenuTrigger');
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, root.triggerRef as RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>);
  const press = useHoverIntent();
  const start = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const lastKeyOpen = useRef(0);
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'div';

  const openFromKeyboard = (target: Element) => {
    const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    lastKeyOpen.current = Date.now();
    cm.openAt(rect.left + Math.min(16, rect.width / 2), rect.bottom, 'keyboard');
  };

  return (
    <Comp
      ref={ref}
      tabIndex={tabIndex ?? (asChild ? undefined : 0)}
      data-state={root.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-context-menu-trigger', className)}
      onContextMenu={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onContextMenu?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented || disabled) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        press.cancel();
        // The keydown already opened the menu; the browser's follow-up event must not move it
        if (Date.now() - lastKeyOpen.current < 400) return;
        cm.openAt(e.clientX, e.clientY, 'pointer');
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onKeyDown?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented || disabled) return;
        if (e.key === 'ContextMenu' || (e.key === 'F10' && e.shiftKey)) {
          e.preventDefault();
          openFromKeyboard(e.target as Element);
        }
      }}
      onPointerDown={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerDown?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented || disabled || e.pointerType === 'mouse') return;
        // Touch and pen: a long press is the right-click
        const { clientX: x, clientY: y } = e;
        start.current = { x, y };
        press.start(() => cm.openAt(x, y, 'pointer'), longPressDelay);
      }}
      onPointerMove={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerMove?.(e);
        const s = start.current;
        if (s && Math.hypot(e.clientX - s.x, e.clientY - s.y) > LONG_PRESS_SLOP) press.cancel();
      }}
      onPointerUp={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerUp?.(e);
        press.cancel();
      }}
      onPointerCancel={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerCancel?.(e);
        press.cancel();
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type ContextMenuContentProps = Omit<
  FloatingContentProps,
  'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'arrow' | 'onOpened' | 'returnFocusRef' | 'skipFocusReturnRef'
>;

/** The menu panel. Opens at the pointer, flips and shifts to stay on screen. */
export const ContextMenuContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ContextMenuContentProps>(function ContextMenuContent(
  { placement = 'bottom-start', offset = 2, className, children, onKeyDown, onPointerLeave, onContextMenu, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const root = useMenuRoot('ContextMenuContent');
  const cm = useContextMenuContext('ContextMenuContent');
  const ownerId = useId();
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, panelRef);
  const activeSub = useRef<ActiveSub | null>(null);
  const panel = useMemo(() => ({ ownerId, activeSub }), [ownerId]);
  const rove = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: ownedItems(ownerId) });

  // The trigger area is not exempt: a right-click on it closes this menu, then opens a fresh one
  useDismiss(root.open, [panelRef], (reason) => {
    root.skipFocusReturn.current = reason === 'outside';
    root.setOpen(false);
  });

  return (
    <FloatingContent
      ref={ref}
      open={root.open}
      anchorRef={cm.anchorRef}
      placement={placement}
      offset={offset}
      role="menu"
      id={root.contentId}
      tabIndex={-1}
      aria-orientation="vertical"
      aria-label="Context menu"
      className={cn('ui-menu ui-context-menu', className)}
      returnFocusRef={root.triggerRef}
      skipFocusReturnRef={root.skipFocusReturn}
      onOpened={(el) => {
        const method = root.openMethod.current;
        if (method === 'pointer') el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        else focusItem(el, ownerId, method === 'keyboard-last' ? 'last' : 'first');
        root.openMethod.current = 'pointer';
      }}
      onContextMenu={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onContextMenu?.(e);
        e.preventDefault();
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onKeyDown?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented || !isOwnEvent(e)) return;
        if (e.key === 'Tab') {
          e.preventDefault();
          root.closeMenu();
          return;
        }
        rove(e);
      }}
      onPointerLeave={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerLeave?.(e);
        const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch' && !activeSub.current && active?.dataset.menuOwner === ownerId) {
          e.currentTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      <MenuPanelContext.Provider value={panel}>{children}</MenuPanelContext.Provider>
    </FloatingContent>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-hover-intent.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';

/**
 * One cancellable timer for hover intent (tooltip delays, submenu open/close).
 * Starting a new timer replaces the previous one; it is cleared on unmount.
 *   const intent = useHoverIntent();
 *   intent.start(() => setOpen(true), 700);   intent.cancel();
 */
export function useHoverIntent() {
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = undefined;
  }, []);

  const start = useCallback(
    (fn: () => void, delay: number) => {
      cancel();
      if (delay <= 0) {
        fn();
        return;
      }
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        timer.current = undefined;
        fn();
      }, delay);
    },
    [cancel],
  );

  useEffect(() => cancel, [cancel]);

  return useMemo(() => ({ start, cancel }), [start, cancel]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-roving-focus.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';

export type Orientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

const isDisabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
  el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.hasAttribute('data-disabled');

/**
 * Arrow-key focus movement across items inside a container, with Home/End
 * and typeahead. Spread the returned handler on the container:
 *   const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="menuitem"]' });
 *   <div role="menu" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>…</div>
 */
export function useRovingFocus({
  itemSelector,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  loop = true,
  typeahead = true,
  onMove,
}: {
  itemSelector: string;
  orientation?: Orientation;
  loop?: boolean;
  typeahead?: boolean;
  onMove?: (item: HTMLElement) => void;
}) {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  return useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const items = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector)).filter(
        (el) => !isDisabled(el) && el.getClientRects().length > 0,
      );
      if (!items.length) return;
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const index = items.findIndex((el) => el === active || (active !== null && el.contains(active)));
      const go = (item: HTMLElement | undefined) => {
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        item.focus();
        onMove?.(item);
      };
      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (index === -1) return items[delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1];
        let next = index + delta;
        if (loop) next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
        else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next));
        return items[next];
      };
      const v = orientation !== 'horizontal';
      const h = orientation !== 'vertical';
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'ArrowDown':
          if (v) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          if (v) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          if (h) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          if (h) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'Home':
          go(items[0]);
          return;
        case 'End':
          go(items[items.length - 1]);
          return;
      }
      if (!typeahead || e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).matches('input, textarea')) return;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      buffer.current += e.key.toLowerCase();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        buffer.current = '';
      }, 500);
      go(items.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer.current)));
    },
    [itemSelector, orientation, loop, typeahead, onMove],
  );
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/context-menu.css`

```css
/* Context menu ------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-context-menu-trigger" data-state="open|closed">   the area (focusable)
   <div class="ui-floating ui-menu ui-context-menu" role="menu">    the panel at the pointer
   The panel and every item reuse the dropdown menu's .ui-menu-* classes.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-context-menu-trigger {
    /* no iOS callout / text selection while a long press is the right-click */
    -webkit-touch-callout: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-context-menu-trigger:focus-visible {
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-context-menu-trigger { -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; }
  }

  /* opens at the pointer, so it grows from that corner */
  .ui-context-menu[data-state="open"] { --ui-pop-y: 0px; }
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

## Usage

**File row** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/context-menu/file-row.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuSub, ContextMenuSubContent, ContextMenuSubTrigger, ContextMenuTrigger, ContextMenuCheckboxItem } from '@/ui/components/context-menu';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const FILES = [
  { name: 'Quarterly report.pdf', size: '2.4 MB', modified: 'Edited 2 days ago' },
  { name: 'Brand guidelines.fig', size: '18.7 MB', modified: 'Edited 3 weeks ago' },
  { name: 'Invoice 0042.pdf', size: '184 KB', modified: 'Edited 1 November' },
];

function FileRow({ name, size, modified, onAction }: (typeof FILES)[number] & { onAction: (text: string) => void }) {
  const [starred, setStarred] = useState(false);
  return (
    <ContextMenu>
      <ContextMenuTrigger className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card px-3 py-2.5">
        <Icon name="file" className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate font-medium">{name}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {size} · {modified}
          </p>
        </div>
        {starred && <Icon name="star" className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" label="Starred" />}
      </ContextMenuTrigger>
      <ContextMenuContent className="w-56">
        <ContextMenuItem icon={<Icon name="external-link" />} shortcut="⌘O" onSelect={() => onAction(`Opened ${name}`)}>
          Open
        </ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem icon={<Icon name="pencil" />} shortcut="F2" onSelect={() => onAction(`Renaming ${name}`)}>
          Rename
        </ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem icon={<Icon name="copy" />} shortcut="⌘D" onSelect={() => onAction(`Duplicated ${name}`)}>
          Duplicate
        </ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuSub>
          <ContextMenuSubTrigger icon={<Icon name="link" />}>Share</ContextMenuSubTrigger>
          <ContextMenuSubContent className="w-48">
            <ContextMenuItem onSelect={() => onAction('Link copied')}>Copy link</ContextMenuItem>
            <ContextMenuItem onSelect={() => onAction('Email draft opened')}>Send by email…</ContextMenuItem>
          </ContextMenuSubContent>
        </ContextMenuSub>
        <ContextMenuCheckboxItem checked={starred} onCheckedChange={setStarred}>
          Starred
        </ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
        <ContextMenuSeparator />
        <ContextMenuItem
          icon={<Icon name="trash" />}
          variant="destructive"
          shortcut="⌫"
          onSelect={() => onAction(`Moved ${name} to trash`)}
        >
          Move to trash
        </ContextMenuItem>
      </ContextMenuContent>
    </ContextMenu>
  );
}

export default function ContextMenuFileRow() {
  const [last, setLast] = useState('Right-click a file (long-press on touch)');
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-2">
      {FILES.map((file) => (
        <FileRow key={file.name} {...file} onAction={setLast} />
      ))}
      <p role="status" className="px-1 pt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {last}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
